title: The Parliamentary Commissioner and Fundamental Rights Oversight

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Originating in Scandinavia, the ombudsman was introduced into Hungarian constitutional law in 1993. The Commissioner investigates constitutional anomalies (*visszásság*) committed by public authorities.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The ombudsman has no coercive force to annul laws or jail officials; their weapon is publicity, thorough investigation (*kivizsgálás*), and morally unassailable recommendations (*ajánlások*).
